steps.note: Open the multi-stage event creation flow.
Configure an RFQ pricing stage for the vendor bid test.
Move to the RFQ stage before configuring its template and sheet.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add one product so the vendor has a pricing sheet to open.
Complete the buyer-side pricing sheet prerequisites.
Invite one vendor to the RFQ.
Publish the event so the vendor can access its bid sheet.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Act as the invited vendor in the supplier portal.
Open the event's pricing sheet with no bid value entered.
Verify that submitting an empty bid is disabled or rejected with refusal evidence.
Return to the buyer console to inspect recorded responses.
Confirm no vendor response or bid appears for the empty submission.
